source_digest_method: sorted Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, src/**/*.rs and examples/**/*.rs; relative path + NUL + bytes + NUL per file
binary_provenance_note: Hand and torus pipeline runs preceded the final rebuild that only scales the estimator work cap and adds budget metadata/guard coverage. The final binary produced the body retry and similarity checks. Its original hand hints exactly match those used by the accepted hand. No old hand-run binary hash was captured.

method.curvature: area-weighted least-squares symmetric normal derivative in connected geodesic neighbourhoods; tensor eigenvector with least absolute curvature
method.thinning: score-ordered geodesic suppression; confidence rounded to 1e-6 for numerical tie stability, then vertex ID
method.unconstrained_regions: flat, isotropic, ill-conditioned, low-signal or poor-fit neighbourhoods
method.work_budget: clamp(vertex_count * 8192, 40_000_000, 400_000_000) edge visits; cancellation checked every 4096 visits
method.cycle_budget: 16 seeds, 512*h physical distance guard, at most 1024 half-spacing levels per seed

research.title: Estimating Curvatures and Their Derivatives on Triangle Meshes
research.author: Szymon Rusinkiewicz
research.use: Normal derivative and neighbourhood-scale background. New code extends the existing neighbourhood least-squares experiment; it is not a port of the per-face tensor algorithm.

limits: Whole-character repair timed out; no accepted whole-character output.
Pole placement and junction distortion remain; worst hand edge-length ratio is still 5.44.
Tilted loop on the opposite outer hand region remains, despite better sampled shape accuracy.
Geometry hint generation uses uniform output spacing, not painted/adaptive spacing.
Direction-only control still excludes hard boundary/sharp constraints; current accepted examples are closed.
Existing guide application uses Euclidean support and normal compatibility; nearby same-facing sheets may interact.
Rotation/scale checks cover hint and path selection, not full remeshing.
No triangulation-independence certificate; finite samples do not prove Hausdorff distance or absence of self-intersection.
Only hand and torus accepted here; no broad suite, CI, platform or UI/persistence/paint integration validation.
